schema_note: Open WebUI v0.13.4 AutomationForm payload (routers/automations.py) for periodic Controlled Serendipity Briefings via kos-engine MCP.
name: Human KOS Controlled Serendipity Briefing
description: Bi-weekly topological serendipity briefing backed by L1 co-occurrence/related edges (polarity=1, IC>=1.5) and DB III activation decay.
prompt: 调用 MCP 工具 `kos_generate_serendipity_briefing`（参数：max_hops=2, min_ic=1.5, top_k=6），基于返回的确定性拓扑证据路径与激活重激活信号，整理一份克制、可读的「受控漫游简报」。要求：1）保留每个推荐概念的 `node_id`、分面与完整证据边路径，不编造图谱之外的关联；2）如返回结果中 `license_boundary.share_alike_triggered` 为 true，应在简报末尾原样保留 CC BY-SA 署名声明；3）给出 2–3 个可点击切入的新探索问题。
